(rule!
  (let* ((bb2 (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 2)))
         (bb3 (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 3)))
         (dr (- (first bb3) (first bb2)))
         (dc (- (second bb3) (second bb2))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([p (in-list (find-color g 4))])
      (set-cell out (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc) 4))))

(rule!
  (let* ((bb2 (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 2)))
         (bb3 (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 3)))
         (dr (- (first bb3) (first bb2)))
         (dc (- (second bb3) (second bb2)))
         (shifted (for/list ([p (in-list (find-color g 4))])
                    (list (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc)))))
    (define cue #f)
    (for* ([p (in-list shifted)] [d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
      (let* ((nr (+ (first p) (first d)))
             (nc (+ (second p) (second d))))
        (when (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
          (let ((v (at g nr nc)))
            (when (member? v '(1 5 6))
              (set! cue v))))))
    (define out (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) shifted 4))
    (paint-cells out (find-color g cue) 8)))
